name: vault-toolkit
description: Three-skill toolkit for building, syncing, and linting a Karpathy-pattern wiki vault. Bundles vault-restructure (intake + routing + manifest), vault-sync (bootstrap or session ingestion + crystallization), and vault-lint (three-tier health checks). The three skills share a manifest schema and vault-index hash chain. Installing any one standalone produces errors; this plugin installs all three with verified compatibility.
